description: Save virtual users to .usercase/people.json (adds to what is there). People have no names — like real visitors; each gets a number (p1, p2…) to refer to them by. Make people who would really come to this site — varied goals, devices, arrival paths, and states of mind. Do not make everyone a perfect fit for one feature. Show the list to the user before running visits.

account.description: Members only: which demo account (a1, a2 …). Leave out — members are spread across the signed-in accounts and keep the same one

arrival.description: How they got here: search engine, a link in a feed or chat, a link someone sent, or typed the address / a bookmark

background.description: Who they are, in one or two sentences

feature.description: Which part of the site this visit is about, from your feature map (e.g. calendar, comments, profile settings). For your coverage only — the visitor never sees it

goal.description: What they came to this site to do or find out, in their own terms

landing.description: The page they land on, as a path on this site (e.g. /bluecard/6553c3ba5fae82d8976b6806, /watchlist, /calendar). The page their search result, link or bookmark would really open — for someone who searched for one announcement, that announcement. Take real paths from check_site's page list or the routes in the code. Leave out to land on the front page

member.description: Already has an account and is signed in (uses a demo account saved by `login`). Mix members and non-members — all members hides what newcomers hit

moment.description: Their state right now: where they are, how much time, mood

surveyHabit.description: How they usually treat pop-up survey cards. Most people ignore them

traits.description: How they move. Omit to derive automatically

research.description: Only when the run takes part in a research — its id, as path_tasks shows it: everyone saved in this call takes part in it

site.description: Site origin the visits go to

site_about.description: One or two English sentences on what the site is, as a visitor would understand it

name: save_people
